about: How an accepted Cotiza quote becomes a Pravara MES order. Cotiza's sender is written against this file and Pravara's tests hold the API to it (apps/pravara-api/internal/api/cotiza_intake_contract_test.go). Cotiza keeps a verbatim copy and tests its payload against that copy: change both copies in the same pair of pull requests, never one. A request field is '<presence> <type>': presence 'required' or 'optional'; type is the JSON type (string, integer, number, boolean, object, array). A UUID or a time is a string; a time is RFC 3339. A response field is '<presence> <type>' with presence 'always'.

auth.bearer: Authorization: Bearer <token>. A Janua client_credentials token of Cotiza's machine client: audience pravara-api, scope pravara-mes:jobs, bound to an organization. The token's tenant_id is the Pravara tenant the order lands in; the body never chooses it.
auth.signature: Lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the exact request body bytes, keyed with a secret shared by both sides. Pravara checks it when its COTIZA_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set and then refuses a request without it (401). Cotiza signs whenever its PRAVARA_DISPATCH_SECRET is set. The two values must be equal.

idempotency: order.id is the order's external id, and Pravara keeps at most one order per tenant and external id: an order.created or order.confirmed for an id the tenant already has answers 200 and changes nothing. A sender may therefore retry or replay the same body freely. Cotiza sends the accepted quote's id, so one accepted quote is one Pravara order.

events.order.created: Create the order and one order item per entry of order.items; production tasks follow when auto-decomposition is on.
events.order.confirmed: Same as order.created. Cotiza sends this one, once the quote is paid and ordered.
events.order.updated: Overwrite customer_name, customer_email, total_amount, currency and due_date of the existing order; priority and metadata only when sent. Items are not changed. Unknown id: 200, nothing changes.
events.order.cancelled: Set the existing order to cancelled. Unknown id: 200, nothing changes.

200.when: The event was processed, or the order already existed (replay).
200.notes: order_id echoes the request's order.id (the external id), not Pravara's own order id.

200_unhandled.when: The event is not one of the four above. Nothing changes.

400.when: The body is not JSON or a required envelope or order field is missing. Do not retry.

401.when: The token is missing, expired or not for this audience, or the signature is missing or wrong. Fetch a new token and retry once; a signature mismatch is a configuration error.

403.when: The token lacks pravara-mes:jobs or carries no tenant. Do not retry.

500.when: Pravara could not read or write the order. Retry with the same body.

retry: Retry the same body on a network error, a timeout, 429 or any 5xx; it is safe because of the idempotency rule. Never retry another 4xx except a 401 after fetching a new token.
sender: Cotiza fills the envelope as follows. event: order.confirmed. order.id: the accepted quote's id. customer_name: the customer's name, else their email, else the quote number. total_amount and currency: the quote's total and currency. items: the quote's fabrication items only (items without a services block); id is the quote item id, product_name the item name, product_sku the process code, quantity and unit_price the quoted ones, specifications holds process, material, quote_item_id, lead_time_days and selections (process and material are what Pravara's machine matching reads). metadata: source 'cotiza', quote_id, quote_number, cotiza_tenant_id, and cotiza_order_id, cotiza_order_number and engagement_id when known.
